command: pre-registration of the Bind plan's offline probes

Q1a.W1: pi0.5's PaliGemma attention from the referent's word tokens (instruction rewritten to name it) to the 256 agent-view tokens, per layer; pointing = its peak token is covered >= 0.1 by the referent
Q1a.W1_layer_rule: the single layer with the highest pointing on validity is W1's layer everywhere else
Q1a.W3: OWLv2 base patch16 ensemble, best box for the referent's phrase; same pointing
Q1a.diagnostic: the action expert's attention mass on each candidate under the task's own instruction (no bias): share of states where the most-attended candidate is the named object
Q1a.gate: a where-source enters Q3 only if pointing >= 0.8 on validity AND >= 0.6 on class_a; W1 and W3 both failing -> the deployable arm has no where-source and Q4 becomes a mechanism read (oracle + controls)

Q1b.configs: target mass rho in {0.3, 0.5, 0.7} x layer band {all 18, mid 6-11}; fixed beta in {4, 8} all layers
Q1b.kill: if CC < 0.1 AND PA gain over the unbiased chunk < 0.1 for EVERY config in the class_a group, BIND stops before any rollout
Q1b.measures: PA (first chunk's horizontal displacement points at the biased candidate), CC (contrast cosine between two candidates' biased chunks and their positions), against PA/CC of the prompt swap (the instruction naming the candidate) as calibration; override diagnostics OS, LS, SHIFT
Q1b.override_flag: a config whose OS or LS median falls below 0.5 is marked overriding and excluded from Q2

metrics.data: experiments/f0b_firstframes_seg.py: first frames of practice init states 0-9 of LIBERO-Goal, LIBERO-Object, LIBERO-90, LIBERO-10, LIBERO-Spatial with per-geom segmentation, depth, camera matrices
metrics.plan: ~/.claude/plans/i-m-interested-in-re-workshopping-quizzical-crane.md (Bind and Chain, 2026-10-01 evening): a new task arrives as instruction + scene, NO demonstration; WHERE from the policy's own model first, an open-vocabulary detector as fallback, simulator segmentation only as an oracle
metrics.tasks: every task with one moved object and >= 2 candidate objects visible (oracle coverage >= 0.1 of some token); groups: validity = LIBERO-Goal, object = LIBERO-Object, class_a = LIBERO-90 tasks 18 26 48 49 52 53 58 59 60 62 65 66 71 38 70, other
metrics.written_before: any output of b1_where_probe.py or b2_steer_offline.py
